$comment: Starting ladders per task type for scripts/route-model.mjs. Rung 0 is the first attempt; each failure moves one rung up. Three rungs maximum: two-model cascades capture almost all of the gain and deeper ones rarely help (arXiv 2605.06350: >2 models added no accuracy in 118 of 135 comparisons). The first escalation raises effort on the same model because that keeps the prompt cache; the second changes model. Recorded outcomes (.svc/model-outcomes.jsonl) override these priors once an arm has enough samples.
failure_penalty_note: Relative cost units charged for each failed attempt (verification time, rework, attention) on top of the spent tokens. Same units as price_out x effort multiplier.

mechanical.why: Renames, formatting, extraction, state hygiene, summaries of known files. Effort guide: low for small changes you review.

exec.why: Implementing an approved plan with a clear scope. Effort guide: medium fits day-to-day engineering with a clear scope.

debug.why: Bug fixing in an existing codebase. Effort guide: high where verification matters or edge cases are likely.

plan.why: Specs, plan-changeset, architecture, strategy: errors here propagate to every later stage.

review.why: Adversarial review of a frozen diff or plan. Same-family review stays advisory; independent review still goes through run-external-review.mjs.

security.why: Vulnerability hunting and auth or secrets work. Effort guide: max for hard problems such as finding security vulnerabilities.

writing.why: Docs, marketing copy, posts, briefs where a person reviews the result.

failure_kinds.verify_fail: A deterministic check failed: tests, validators, receipt check, review FAIL. Escalate one rung.
failure_kinds.capability: The model could not make progress (maxTurns reached, repeated identical error, gave up). Skip to the next rung that changes model.
failure_kinds.context: Ran out of context or lost the thread after compaction. Skip to the next rung that changes model.
failure_kinds.refusal: Safety refusal. Do not escalate here; Claude Code's automatic fallback handles it.
failure_kinds.infra: Overload, network, rate limit. Retry the same rung; fallbackModel chains handle availability.
